## Verdict

**Lumen Path** costs least for a team of 30, at **$270 per month**. All three vendors have minimums below 30 seats, so no one is forced to buy unused capacity — the ranking follows the per-seat rates directly. Estuary is $420 and Gable is $630.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Gable | $21 | 1 |
| Lumen Path | $9 | 10 |
| Estuary | $14 | 25 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for = the greater of 30 (team size) or the vendor minimum. Every minimum here (1, 10, 25) falls below 30, so all three bill for exactly 30 seats.

- **Lumen Path:** 30 × $9 = **$270 per month**
- **Estuary:** 30 × $14 = **$420 per month**
- **Gable:** 30 × $21 = **$630 per month**

Lumen Path is $150 per month cheaper than Estuary and $360 per month cheaper than Gable — $1,800 and $4,320 per year respectively. Spread between cheapest and dearest is 2.3×.

## Risks

Seat minimums are inert at this headcount but become live if the team shrinks. Below 25 people Estuary still bills $350; below 10 people Lumen Path still bills $90. Gable's 1-seat minimum means it is the only vendor with no floor exposure, which matters for a contracting team even though it is the most expensive option at 30.

Growth does not change the ranking. All three scale linearly from 30 seats with no further tiers on the list, so Lumen Path stays cheapest at any size above 30, and its absolute lead widens by $5 per added seat against Estuary and $12 against Gable.

This is a price comparison only. The list carries no information on features, support tiers, usage limits, security posture, or integrations, so the cheapest seat may not be a comparable product. All figures are list prices billed monthly as stated; annual commitments, volume discounts, onboarding fees, and migration costs are not in the source and could reorder these totals.
